rationale: Feature selection excludes identifiers (claim_id, member_id, rendering_npi), fraud_pattern_type (only populated when fraud_label=1, introducing leakage per T5 feedback), high_cost_flag (pre-computed), and paid_amount (outcome-determined). This uses submission-time features only. Test split of 0.25 matches task spec (quarter held out). Stratification preserves fraud-class balance. Preprocessing fitted on training data only prevents leakage. Random forest selected as tree-based complement to logistic regression per task requirement. Balanced class weighting addresses imbalanced fraud distribution. Report caveats address synthetic data, operational limits, and class imbalance; show_denominators and cite_artifacts enable reproducibility per feedback patterns in T7-T9.
